acceptanceCriteria.text: package.json at repo root with workspaces: ['apps/*', 'packages/*']
pnpm install succeeds from repo root

checkpointPayload.title: Init pnpm workspace at repo root

taskChanges.newValue:
1. Install pnpm globally (npm i -g pnpm) if not present
2. Create pnpm-workspace.yaml at repo root: packages: ['apps/*', 'packages/*']
3. Add 'private: true' and 'workspaces: [apps/*, packages/*]' to existing root package.json (do NOT move files yet)
4. Create empty apps/ and packages/ stub directories
5. Run pnpm install from repo root — verify success
6. Commit: chore: init pnpm workspace
